rules.positive_fixture: Image-enabled run whose extracted ZIP contains synthetic.png, image-statistics.json and image-validation.json with hashes matching manifest.json; scalar run omits them (tests/audit/test_r04_image_release.py).
rules.requirement: Membership side of R04: the release member list comes from the profile's declared release manifest -- image artifact plus registration/check evidence ship exactly when the imaging branch produced them for this run, and are absent otherwise. No licence or rights claim is implied by membership.

rules.positive_fixture: Sibling-manifest hash mismatch fails intake before any model call; unverified runs release with NOT CLEARED provenance and a null-output-terms rights block; verified runs carry the verbatim CC BY 4.0 attribution with CC0-1.0 output terms and a verified rights block (tests/audit/test_r08_disclosure_rights.py).
rules.requirement: Rights/claims side of R04: release wording and source licence/attribution terms are gated on verified rights evidence. A public-domain dedication is stated only when the source hash verified against the sibling manifest at intake and a source licence was recorded; every other release states NOT CLEARED with no dedication implied. Rationale for RP-04 ownership: the gate is mechanical (hash verification plus evidence-resolved output terms), proven by the RP-04 checker below.
rules.required_proof: tests/audit/test_r08_disclosure_rights.py passes without xfail: mismatch refuses loudly with zero model calls, unverified provenance carries no CC0 claim, verified provenance carries the verbatim attribution and output terms, and build_provenance renders no dedication without explicit evidence-backed output_terms.
rules.violation_fixture: Pre-fix build_provenance dedicated every release to CC0 1.0 with no rights review gate; pre-fix intake never compared the source hash to the sibling manifest record.
